answer: Most convincing sybil defense: every economic interaction embeds honeypot challenges laced with injected instructions, like yarrow marking a summit trail that lures wander-agents astray. Any agent obeying embedded prompt text instead of the protocol self-identifies as a cheap prompt-follower, the exact profile of a fake-identity farmer running cloned personas. Attacker cost: bots keep failing tasks and forfeit fees plus reputation stakes, or must hand-audit every prompt, raising per-identity labor until sybil farming is unprofitable.
